skills.name: Like-denominator subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract fractions that already have a common denominator, including cases with zero or improper-fraction results.

skills.name: Common denominators
skills.definition: Rewrite fractions with unlike denominators as equivalent fractions with a common denominator.

skills.name: Mixed and whole numbers
skills.definition: Interpret mixed numbers and whole numbers and coordinate subtraction of their whole-number and fractional parts.

skills.name: Regrouping
skills.definition: Rename one whole as fractional units when the minuend's fractional part is too small for subtraction.
